bio.text: Kelly Cassidy, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 14th House District since May 2011, according to the General Assembly.
Her General Assembly biography lists her as a former legislative director for the National Organization for Women and a former legislative aide to State Senator John Cullerton.
It also lists her as a former deputy director of intergovernmental affairs and director of programs and development in the Cook County State's Attorney's Office.
